issues.description: The problem statement explicitly requires the Farm to use a List implemented with an ArrayList and to initialize the ArrayList in the no-arg constructor, but the solution implements the animals collection as a Set backed by a HashSet. This is a structural mismatch: the collection type (List/ArrayList vs Set/HashSet) differs between the specification and the solution. This also changes ordering semantics (ArrayList preserves insertion order; HashSet does not), which can affect song output order and produce surprising behavior or failing tests if tests or student expectations rely on the specified ordering.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the collection type across all artifacts. Preferably change the solution to use a List<Animal> with an ArrayList implementation and initialize it in the no-argument constructor (e.g., private List<Animal> animals; this.animals = new ArrayList<>();), and ensure getters/setters use List<Animal>. Alternatively, update the problem statement and template to accept a Set and explicitly document the change, but keeping the originally specified List/ArrayList is recommended to preserve insertion-order behavior required by the song output.
